About us | Your B2B prospecting partner | Sopro

# Experts in B2B outreach.

 Explore our story, meet our team, or discover career opportunities.

## We are Sopro

At Sopro we believe that all businesses deserve access to top-tier sales engagement strategies. Our mission? To empower businesses to sell more, discovering and engaging their future customers in ways they never thought possible.

We've created a fully managed service that blends email, LinkedIn messaging, social display ads, phone outreach, and even physical mail into a cohesive, powerful outreach strategy. All of this is underpinned by cutting-edge technology and AI, making it as effective as it is effortless for our clients.

But we're not just providing a service; we're changing the game.

### It all started with a simple idea…

Sopro was founded by Rob Harlow and Ryan Welmans in 2015 with one simple goal: transform the way businesses find new clients.

Seeing how time-consuming and unreliable traditional prospecting could be, they set out to create a smarter approach by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology to reach decision-makers effectively.

### Then we innovated and evolved…

Originally, Sopro focused primarily on email prospecting, but as the sales landscape evolved, so did we.

We still combine the best tech with the smartest people, but today, our service includes multiple channels, one-to-one personalised messaging, buyer intent signals, and AI-enhanced audience building.

### And now, we’re driving growth worldwide…

Our commitment to transparency and results-driven campaigns has always set us apart. Now 10 years on, with over 300 employees worldwide, Sopro continues to innovate B2B sales engagement.

To date, we’ve helped over 3,000 B2B businesses grow faster and sell more by delivering high-quality leads.

 3,375 Clients 

 22,839 Campaigns 

 91,384,357 Outreach messages 

 

 630,388 Conversations started

### Careers

Join Sopro and be part of a fast-growing, innovative team that’s transforming B2B sales. We offer exciting career opportunities, a supportive environment, and the chance to make a real impact from day one.

### Life at Sopro

Life at Sopro is dynamic, inclusive, and rewarding. From personal development opportunities to team events and a great work-life balance, we believe in building a culture where people thrive and enjoy what they do every day.

### We are ambitious

We set ambitious goals for ourselves and clear paths to success in order to provide the highest-performing solutions for our customers.

Driven. Focused. Energised. Accountable. Relentless.

### We invest

We invest in building long-term relationships with our customers and our partners. We invest in our exceptional people, in highperforming tech and the products and services we provide to enable our customers to succeed.

Enable. Empower. Develop. Thrive. Future.

### We are people

We highly value and respect the individuality of our customers and partners and their varied business challenges. We go beyond to provide an effective, professional service that supports their business.

Exceptional. Individuality. Collaborative. Supportive. Inclusive.

### We are open

We are clear about who we are, what we do and how we do it. We listen carefully to our exceptional people, customers and partners to build trusted relationships and provide the highest-performing sales engagement solutions to support their success.

Transparent. Trusted. Valued. Approachable. Authentic. 

## Our leadership team

#### Victoria Heyward

Director of Marketing

Vic leads the UK marketing team at Sopro, overseeing the brand's strategic and creative direction. With a deep commitment to transforming the perception of B2B marketing, her strategic vision and innovative approach drive impactful campaigns that resonate across the industry.

#### Steve Harlow

Head of Sales

Steve accidentally fell into sales 20 years ago. He’s done everything from cold calling to managing multiple sales teams. He joined Sopro in the early days and now heads up all things sales.

#### Monika Joshevska

Group COO and Country Manager

Monika, Sopro's first employee in Macedonia, joined in 2016. She oversees service delivery, working across Operations, Reporting, R&D, and Tech. Her team of prospecting experts manages campaigns daily, delivering outstanding results for clients.

#### Heather Hayward

Head of Finance

Heather oversees Sopro's global finance operations, managing forecasting, budgeting, analysis and reporting. A Fellow Chartered and Certified Accountant (FCCA) with over ten years of experience and a first-class mathematics degree, Heather's sharp financial insight supports Sopro's growth.

#### Rob Harlow

Co-founder and CEO

Rob's been a dedicated geek since getting a ZX Spectrum at 8. When he sold his first website at 12 he realised it could be a career. Today, he oversees all things tech at Sopro. He wrote the first line of code and now leads a team of 30+ engineers.

#### Ryan Welmans

Co-founder and Chairman

As a co-founder and Chairman, Ryan brings a wealth of commercial experience and technical insight to our board. He now focuses on high-level advisory and strategic oversight, ensuring Sopro remains on its growth trajectory.

Rob Harlow | Sopro

# Rob Harlow

Co-founder and CEO

## About Rob

As Co-founder and CEO at Sopro, Rob Harlow leads the technical vision behind the company’s prospecting, automation, and multi-channel sales and marketing platforms. Over the past nine years, he has helped scale Sopro from a small team focused on outbound email automation into a 250+ strong organisation delivering complex, data-driven sales and marketing strategies.

With a background in software engineering and a deep passion for automation, Rob is a true technical polymath. He has worked with over 30 programming languages, building everything from distributed CRM platforms to websites and internal systems, always focused on making processes smarter, more efficient, and scalable.

Rob brings a product-led, engineering-first mindset to prospecting and deliverability, balancing technical best practices with a strong belief that long-term success comes from relevance, engagement, and trust, rather than shortcuts or volume-led tactics.

### Career highlights

- Co-founder of Sopro, helping scale the business over 9+ years
- Architect behind Sopro’s automation, deliverability, and innovation strategy
- Coding polyglot with experience across 30+ programming languages
- Built distributed CRM platforms, automation systems, and web products
- Actively supports early-stage tech startups through Sopro’s Founders Hub incubator

### Deliverability isn’t about forcing more emails into the inbox; it’s about relevance. Who you’re emailing, why it matters to them, and whether they genuinely expect to hear from you. That’s what creates engagement, trust, and sustainable deliverability over time.

 Rob Harlow | Co-founder and CEO 

### Expertise

Sales and marketing automation • Email deliverability • Prospecting technology • Product and platform innovation • Software engineering • Multi-channel outreach strategy

### Education

BEng (Hons) Software Engineering, The University of Sheffield

 You don’t have time to manage every team You don’t have the expertise to accelerate specific goals You don’t have enough leads You lack CRM expertise Your brand presence needs improvement You aren’t retaining customers You’re not closing enough deals You can’t find their contact information Your overhead cost is high 

#### Lead your team without supervising every member

Managing each team alone can be taxing. You have to be in charge of each department’s strategic vision — all while holding your team members accountable to standards and deadlines. Outsourcing allows you to focus on your core tasks, as you can trust in the built-in management layer to lead the team for you.

#### Get personalized solutions and insights

In order to achieve your ambitions, you can’t rely on task-doers; you need seasoned experts. By outsourcing, you can partner with professionals who can provide strategic insights based on their experience working across multiple industries.

#### Expand your sales pipeline with persistent outreach

A sales development team allows you to get in front of your prospects through cold calling and inbound lead follow-up. Our BDRs follow our EBQ call cadence and lead qualification criteria to ensure we’re properly qualifying your prospects before sending them to your sales team.

#### Optimize your CRM platform architecture under expert guidance

A robust tool, like Salesforce and HubSpot, requires an expert team to properly set up, run, and maximize your CRM utility. Our certified and experienced admins are trained to adapt your business workflows and integrate your tool seamlessly with your organization. We’ll also train your team to familiarize them with your chosen CRM.

#### Create a strong first impression using branded assets

An omnichannel presence is pertinent to staying top-of-mind for your leads. Our content marketers, graphic designers, web developers, paid advertisers, and marketing automation experts empower your organization to create branded assets to elevate your brand experience.

#### Deepen your customer relationships to expand sales opportunities

Happy customers lead to a future-proof organization, so make sure you’re doing everything you can to satisfy your customers. Our customer service reps dig into your current customer database, answer questions, and actively look for upsell opportunities on your behalf.

#### Convert more opportunities into happy customers

A healthy sales pipeline requires regular follow-ups and multiple ongoing negotiations. Outsourcing your sales team enables you to focus on your core business functions, as our sales experts close deals on your behalf.

#### Develop your personalized B2B contact database

Finding fresh, verified contact information is an arduous process. Our data specialists access industry-leading databases, use proprietary data scraping technology to collect prospects’ contact information, and then manually verify their information before sending it to your sales team.

#### Bypass recruiting, benefits, and miscellaneous costs

Maintaining an in-house team is expensive. Not only do you have to pay a competitive salary, but you also have to allocate funds for their equipment, tools, healthcare benefits, 401k, and more. By outsourcing, you’ll be able to bypass all HR-related costs while keeping your productivity high.

## Common Use Cases

## Vertical Testing

Your product/service is selling positively in a small sample size. You want to pour gasoline on the fire and saturate the market as quickly as possible.

## Limited Capacity

## Our Technology Stack

## Build Awareness

Identify target accounts and prospects, source accurate contact information, create content that resonates with their pain points, then develop a frictionless experience to learn more about your business and why it’s relevant to them.

## Drive Leads

Distribute your content, message, and call to actions to the right prospects at precisely the right time, converting contacts to inbound leads ready to speak with a salesperson.

## Increase Sales

Build a high caliber sales team, complete with experienced sellers and leadership, equipped to field inbound leads and conduct omnichannel outbound campaigns that scale.

## What We Provide

## Sales Teams

Building a sales team is time consuming, expensive and risky. JumpCrew cuts your inefficiencies of learning and helps you scale over time. Proven sales talent, sales playbooks and training, and experienced leadership gets you to market fast and efficient.

## Marketing Agency

Successful sales teams have sales enablement marketing support to create and capture demand, accelerating revenue growth faster than sales teams alone. JumpCrew provides an in house marketing agency to enable sales teams to hit their number faster.

## Revenue Operations

The glue that holds everything together, Revenue Operations engineers the technology stack that supports sustainable growth. From CRM to data enrichment, dashboards and automation, JumpCrew provides the infrastructural backbone.

## Reporting and Optimization

Decisions are made with data. JumpCrew has built a stack of reporting and analytics tools to visualize and contextualize performance across your GTM stack. Weekly, bi-monthly, QBR, and live reporting dashboards provide ongoing insights.

# Every Stage, One Partner.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is my sales team fully dedicated to my organization?

Yes, your sales team is fully dedicated to your account, from their first day of training and beyond, focused entirely on producing results for you.

Does my sales team ever mention JumpCrew?

No, they are white labeled, including email address, LinkedIn profile, and how they introduce themselves to prospects. There is never any mention of JumpCrew during their sales activities.

Are your sales teams and leadership based in the US?

Yes, all of our salespeople, leadership, marketing and support teams are all based in the US, mostly in our Nashville, TN headquarters where the majority of our teams work in office.

When can we expect to see results?

The timeline for and type of results vary on a number of factors, including your ICP, total addressable market, product/service complexity, competitive landscape, market saturation, historical sales data, and existing operational preparedness.

We set ultra conservative expectations for a 90-day ramp timeline from go live, which means we consider sales teams “fully ramped” after that period.

During those 90-days and beyond there is a constant reassessing of what’s working, what isn’t working, and how best to pivot to produce results.

After 12-months of working with us, our clients typically see an average 7:1 ROI, reflected as either net new pipeline or close won new business.

Who are the salespeople assigned to my account?

We source the best possible candidates through our in house talent acquisition team, receiving almost 1,000 monthly applications on our open sales roles. Our team identifies the candidates best suited for the uniqueness of each client account. We can also source available talent from our in house brands owned by JumpCrew.

Do you offer any performance guarantees?

We’re committed to modeling a reasonable expectation of outcomes for each of our clients before a formal engagement, but we do not offer any performance guarantees.

What's included in an engagement with JumpCrew?

We develop bespoke engagement models for each client based on their use case and market opportunity, but the following are included in most engagements:

1. Dedicated Sales Team (BDR, SDR, AE)
2. Sales Manager
3. Sales Director
4. Sales Vice President
5. Sales Senior Vice President
6. Benefits, Insurance, Payroll, Taxes
7. Commissions
8. Operations Manager
9. Learning & Development Manager
10. Hardware/Software
11. Prospect and Target Account Data Lists
12. Omnichannel Outbound/Inbound Campaign Development

How does billing work?

After finalizing a partnership agreement with us, the first invoice is sent along with a payment link and/or ACH instructions and are billed on the 1st of every month. We also offer quarterly and annual payment options with discount incentives.

How does JumpCrew ensure data security and confidentiality?

We adhere to all industry standard security and privacy guidelines to either work within our client’s systems and tools, or to share data back and forth between our systems and tools and our clients.

Can JumpCrew integrate with our existing CRM and marketing tools?

Yes. We can work within your existing systems and tools, assuming seats/licenses are provided to our team.

What is the typical onboarding process and timeline?

After signing an engagement agreement, we initiate a tried and true 30-day onboarding process that includes modules around talent and team, CRM and operations, sales talk track and objections, training and sales collateral, KPI and quota build out, and collecting media assets.

How does JumpCrew measure and report on campaign success?

At a minimum, our clients meet with their assigned sales leadership team weekly, reviewing performance and outcomes from the previous week and pivoting the tactical approach for the upcoming week. Reports are visualized in a Monday.com dashboard that provides qualitative and quantitative insights.

Can you provide case studies or references from similar companies?

We have a library of examples and use cases that’s easily referenceable for you to find similar companies we’ve previously worked with, or currently do.

What level of involvement is required from our internal team?

On average, you can expect approximately 5-10 hours of dedicated, scheduled calls during the onboarding process. After onboarding, we ask for no less than 1 hours for weekly progress reporting, along with as-needed communication by email, phone, or instant messaging.
